name: 909 Kit XL
notes: The 909 Kit with a full voice on every row and the TR-909's TOTAL ACCENT (Macros). Rows: kick, snare, clap (its own noise, three bursts and a tail), closed hat, open hat (its own metal and noise; the closed hat cuts it), low tom, rim, high tom (row 8: the TR-909 has no cowbell). The mid tom, crash and ride do not fit eight rows.
